sourceNotice.zh: 依据第一讲32页PPT及9月8日教师语音转录。仅标识PPT实际黄色高亮；PDSA四步骤细节标明为学习扩展。

objective.en: Understand the meaning, dimensions and stakeholders of healthcare quality.
objective.zh: 理解医疗质量的含义、维度与利益相关者。

sections.title: PPT 6 · The Hong Kong Q-Mark Product Scheme
sections.html:
香港Q-Mark优质产品认证 · 3 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 6
A Q-Mark certification assesses both compliance with product standards and an effective management system that maintains consistent quality.
Q-Mark认证同时关注产品是否符合标准，以及企业能否通过有效的管理体系维持稳定一致的质量。

Effective quality management system / 有效的质量管理体系

PPT原始黄色高亮 / ORIGINAL YELLOW HIGHLIGHT
effective quality management system
English · PPT content
The scheme endorses companies that have a management system capable of delivering consistent product quality.
中文 · 课件对应解释
该计划认可拥有有效质量管理体系、能够持续生产质量稳定产品的企业。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 6

Consistent quality products / 质量稳定一致的产品

PPT原始黄色高亮 / ORIGINAL YELLOW HIGHLIGHT
consistent quality products
English · PPT content
Product quality should remain consistent, rather than depend on one successful inspection.
中文 · 课件对应解释
产品质量应持续稳定，而不只是某次抽检合格。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 6

Standards / 标准

PPT原始黄色高亮 / ORIGINAL YELLOW HIGHLIGHT
standards
English · PPT content
The Council tests products against international or national standards and assesses the quality management system.
中文 · 课件对应解释
Q-Mark Council根据国际或国家标准检测产品，同时评估申请企业的质量管理体系。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 6

sections.title: PPT 12 · Understanding the Meaning of Healthcare Quality
sections.html:
理解医疗质量的含义 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 12
Healthcare quality combines four aims: effective improvement of patient outcomes; safe and effective care; timely, efficient services; and equitable, patient-centered decisions.
医疗质量包含四项目标：有效改善患者治疗结果；提供安全、有效的治疗；及时、高效地提供服务；公平地提供以患者为中心的照护。

Patient Outcomes Improvement / 改善患者治疗结果

PPT原始黄色高亮 / ORIGINAL YELLOW HIGHLIGHT
effectively
English · PPT content
Healthcare quality focuses on services that effectively improve health and recovery outcomes.
中文 · 课件对应解释
医疗质量关注医疗服务能否有效改善患者健康状况和康复结果。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 12

Safety and Effectiveness / 安全性与有效性

PPT原始黄色高亮 / ORIGINAL YELLOW HIGHLIGHT
safe and effective · minimizing · maximizing
English · PPT content
Treatments should be safe and effective, minimizing risks and maximizing benefits for patients.
中文 · 课件对应解释
治疗必须安全且有效，在降低患者风险的同时尽可能提高获益。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 12

Timely and Efficient Care / 及时且高效的医疗服务

PPT原始黄色高亮 / ORIGINAL YELLOW HIGHLIGHT
better patient experience
English · PPT content
Reduce delays and optimize resource use to provide a better patient experience.
中文 · 课件对应解释
减少等待和延误、优化资源使用，从而改善患者的就医体验。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 12

Equitable and Patient-Centered / 公平且以患者为中心

PPT原始黄色高亮 / ORIGINAL YELLOW HIGHLIGHT
respects
English · PPT content
Ensure equitable access and respect patient preferences and values when making care decisions.
中文 · 课件对应解释
确保公平获得医疗服务，并在医疗决策中尊重患者的偏好与价值观。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 12
Classroom commentary / 老师课堂补充

Lecturer: effectiveness and outcomes / 老师补充：有效性和治疗结果

The lecturer linked outcomes to recovery, reduced suffering and the length of hospital stay; he also discussed respecting the patient’s preferences.
老师将治疗结果与康复、减少痛苦及住院天数联系起来，并强调治疗时要尊重患者意愿。
Lesson 1-a

sections.title: PPT 13 · Key Dimensions of Quality in Healthcare Services
sections.html:
医疗服务质量的五个关键维度 · 5 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 13
Remember five dimensions: Safety, Effectiveness, Patient-Centeredness, Timeliness and Efficiency, and Equity.
记住五个维度：安全性、有效性、以患者为中心、及时性与效率、公平性。

Safety in Healthcare / 医疗安全

English · PPT content
Prevent harm during care and build trust in medical services.
中文 · 课件对应解释
预防医疗过程中的伤害，并建立患者对医疗服务的信任。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 13

Effectiveness of Care / 医疗有效性

PPT原始黄色高亮 / ORIGINAL YELLOW HIGHLIGHT
desired health outcomes
English · PPT content
Provide evidence-based treatments to achieve desired health outcomes.
中文 · 课件对应解释
提供循证治疗，以实现预期的健康结果。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 13

Patient-Centeredness / 以患者为中心

English · PPT content
Care must respond to each patient’s preferences, needs and values.
中文 · 课件对应解释
医疗服务应尊重并回应每位患者的偏好、需求与价值观。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 13

Timeliness and Efficiency / 及时性与效率

English · PPT content
Reduce waiting times and optimize resources to improve healthcare access and delivery.
中文 · 课件对应解释
缩短等候时间并优化资源配置，提高医疗服务可及性及服务效率。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 13

Equity in Healthcare / 医疗公平

English · PPT content
Care quality should not vary because of personal characteristics or demographics.
中文 · 课件对应解释
医疗质量不应因个人特征或人口背景而不同。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 13
Classroom commentary / 老师课堂补充

Lecturer: waiting time and safety / 老师补充：等待时间和安全

An A&E waiting-time experience illustrated timeliness and resource constraints; falls and pressure injuries were given as examples of preventable harm.
老师通过急症室长时间等候说明及时性与资源限制，并以跌倒、长期卧床造成的皮肤损伤举例说明可预防伤害。
Lesson 1-a

sections.title: PPT 14 · Stakeholder Perspectives on Quality
sections.html:
利益相关者对医疗质量的不同关注 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 14
Different stakeholders define quality through different priorities: patients, providers, payers and regulators.
不同利益相关者关注点不同：患者重视体验，服务提供者重视临床结果，支付方重视成本与价值，监管机构重视合规与标准。

Patient Priorities / 患者关注点

English · PPT content
Patients focus on satisfaction and effective communication. The slide also points to patients’ rights and responsibilities.
中文 · 课件对应解释
患者重视满意度、有效沟通、患者权利及责任。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 14

Provider Focus / 医疗服务提供者的关注点

English · PPT content
Providers focus on clinical outcomes and adherence to best practices.
中文 · 课件对应解释
医护人员重视临床结果及遵循最佳实践。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 14

Payer Concerns / 医疗支付方的关注点

English · PPT content
Payers focus on cost efficiency and value-based care in quality-improvement decisions.
中文 · 课件对应解释
医疗支付方重视成本效率及以价值为基础的医疗服务。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 14

Regulatory Role / 监管机构的作用

English · PPT content
Regulators focus on compliance and standards that ensure safety and quality.
中文 · 课件对应解释
监管机构重视法规合规及保障安全、质量的相关标准。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 14

objective.en: Identify quality-cost categories and ways to reduce failure costs.
objective.zh: 掌握质量成本类型及成本控制方法。

sections.title: PPT 16 · Types of Quality Costs: Prevention, Appraisal, and Failure
sections.html:
质量成本的三种类型 · 3 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 16
Quality costs = Prevention Costs + Appraisal Costs + Failure Costs. Distinguish spending before errors, spending to detect errors, and the losses from errors.
质量成本＝预防成本＋评估成本＋失败成本：分别对应提前预防、检查发现问题和错误发生后的损失。

Prevention Costs / 预防成本

English · PPT content
Investment made to prevent defects before they occur (e.g., training, procedures and checklists).
中文 · 课件对应解释
问题发生之前，为避免缺陷或错误而投入的成本，例如培训、规程与检查清单。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 16

Appraisal Costs / 评估成本

English · PPT content
Expenses for evaluation and inspection to detect defects early (e.g., checks and quality audits).
中文 · 课件对应解释
用于评估与检查、及早发现缺陷的开支，例如检查和质量审核。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 16

Failure Costs / 失败成本

English · PPT content
Costs arising from defects detected internally or externally, including rework and customer dissatisfaction.
中文 · 课件对应解释
内部或外部发现缺陷后产生的成本，包括返工和服务对象不满。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 16

sections.title: PPT 17 · Implications of Quality Costs on Healthcare Organizations
sections.html:
质量成本对医疗机构的影响 · 3 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 17
Investing in prevention and appraisal can reduce failures; healthcare organizations must balance quality, safety and efficient resource use.
增加适当的预防与评估投入有助于降低失败成本；医疗机构须兼顾质量、安全和资源使用效率。

High Failure Costs / 高额失败成本

English · PPT content
Failures consume financial resources and can harm patient outcomes and safety.
中文 · 课件对应解释
错误可能消耗大量财务资源，并损害患者治疗结果与安全。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 17

Prevention and Appraisal Investment / 预防与评估投入

English · PPT content
Investment in prevention and appraisal can avoid errors, protect care quality and reduce overall failure-related costs.
中文 · 课件对应解释
投资于预防与评估，有助于减少错误、保障质量并降低失败相关的总成本。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 17

Balancing Quality and Efficiency / 平衡质量与效率

English · PPT content
Allocate resources efficiently and maximize quality without overspending.
中文 · 课件对应解释
有效分配资源，避免过度支出，同时保持较高质量。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 17

sections.title: PPT 18 · Strategies for Reducing Quality Costs
sections.html:
降低质量成本的四种策略 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 18
Four cost-reduction strategies: Quality Improvement Programs, Staff Training, Standardized Protocols, and Technology for Error Prevention.
降低质量成本的四种策略：质量改善计划、员工培训、标准化规程、错误预防技术。

Quality Improvement Programs / 质量改善计划

English · PPT content
Improve care processes to reduce defects and failure-related costs.
中文 · 课件对应解释
改进医疗流程，减少缺陷及失败产生的成本。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 18

Staff Training / 员工培训

English · PPT content
Train employees in standards and procedures to reduce errors.
中文 · 课件对应解释
培训员工掌握标准与操作程序，以减少错误。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 18

Standardized Protocols / 标准化操作规程

English · PPT content
Promote consistency in processes to minimize mistakes.
中文 · 课件对应解释
提高医疗流程的一致性，减少差错。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 18

Technology for Error Prevention / 错误预防技术

English · PPT content
Use technology to detect and prevent errors early.
中文 · 课件对应解释
利用技术及早发现和预防错误。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 18
Classroom commentary / 老师课堂补充

Lecturer: standardized care / 老师补充：标准化医疗流程

The lecturer explained that standardized protocols and staff training can limit unnecessary investigations and prevent errors.
老师指出标准化规程及员工培训有助于减少不必要检查及预防差错。
Lesson 1-a

objective.en: Explain QA, RCA, PDSA and quality measurement.

sections.title: PPT 20 · Definition and Goals of Quality Assurance
sections.html:
质量保证（QA）的定义与目标 · 3 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 20
QA (Quality Assurance) uses monitoring and evaluation to maintain quality, prevent errors, and support continuous improvement.
QA = Quality Assurance（质量保证）：通过监控与评估维持及提升质量、预防错误、推动持续改进。

Maintain and Improve Quality / 维持与提升质量

English · PPT content
Monitor and evaluate care to maintain and improve its quality.
中文 · 课件对应解释
通过监控及评估，维持并改善医疗服务质量。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 20

Error Prevention / 预防错误

English · PPT content
Identify risks and implement corrective actions proactively.
中文 · 课件对应解释
主动识别风险，并提前实施纠正措施。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 20

Continuous Improvement / 持续改进

English · PPT content
Continuously strengthen patient safety and satisfaction over time.
中文 · 课件对应解释
持续提升患者安全和满意度。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 20

sections.title: PPT 21 · Core Components of Quality Assurance Systems
sections.html:
QA体系的四个核心组成部分 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 21
A QA system needs clear standards, performance monitoring, audits, and staff participation in improvement.
QA体系由制定质量标准、监控绩效、开展审核和员工参与改进四部分组成。

Setting Quality Standards / 制定质量标准

English · PPT content
Define clear standards to guide performance and ensure consistent care delivery.
中文 · 课件对应解释
制定明确标准，指导工作表现，保证医疗服务持续一致。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 21

Monitoring Performance / 监控表现

English · PPT content
Monitor regularly to identify gaps and track progress toward quality goals.
中文 · 课件对应解释
定期监测绩效，识别差距并追踪质量目标达成情况。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 21

Conducting Audits / 开展审核

English · PPT content
Objectively assess processes and compliance with quality standards.
中文 · 课件对应解释
客观评估流程以及对质量标准的遵循程度。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 21

Engaging Staff in Improvement / 鼓励员工参与改善

English · PPT content
Involve staff to promote continuous improvement and accountability.
中文 · 课件对应解释
让员工参与，推动持续改善及责任落实。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 21

sections.title: PPT 22 · Quality Assurance Tools and Techniques in Healthcare
sections.html:
医疗质量保证的四种工具与技术 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 22
RCA = Root Cause Analysis (find underlying causes); PDSA = Plan–Do–Study–Act (repeatedly test improvements); audits/benchmarking compare with standards; indicators measure performance.
RCA = Root Cause Analysis（根本原因分析），用于找原因；PDSA = Plan–Do–Study–Act（计划—执行—研究—行动），用于循环测试改进；临床审核与基准比较用于对标；绩效指标用于衡量表现。

Root Cause Analysis (RCA) / 根本原因分析

English · PPT content
Find underlying causes of problems to help prevent recurrence.
中文 · 课件对应解释
寻找问题的深层原因，以防止类似事件再次发生。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 22

PDSA = Plan–Do–Study–Act / PDSA循环＝计划—执行—研究—行动

PDSA = PLAN → DO → STUDY → ACT
PDSA＝计划 → 执行 → 研究 → 行动
Purpose / 用途：Iteratively test and improve healthcare processes / 反复测试与改善医疗流程。
English · PPT content
Plan–Do–Study–Act cycles iteratively test and improve healthcare processes.
中文 · 课件对应解释
通过计划—执行—研究—行动的循环，反复测试并改善医疗流程。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 22

Clinical Audits and Benchmarking / 临床审核与基准比较

English · PPT content
Compare healthcare performance against standards to guide improvement.
中文 · 课件对应解释
将医疗表现与标准或基准比较，以推动改进。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 22

Performance Indicators / 绩效指标

English · PPT content
Measure important dimensions of quality to monitor and improve service delivery.
中文 · 课件对应解释
衡量医疗质量的关键方面，监测并改善服务表现。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 22
Classroom commentary / 老师课堂补充

Lecturer: scope of this lesson / 老师补充：第一讲范围

RCA and PDSA were introduced briefly; the lecturer said these tools would be discussed in more detail in subsequent lectures.
老师在第一讲简要介绍RCA和PDSA，并表示后续课程会进一步展开。
Lesson 1-b

sections.title: PDSA = Plan–Do–Study–Act / 四步骤详解（学习扩展）
sections.html:
PDSA = Plan–Do–Study–Act — a repeated improvement cycle.
PDSA＝计划（Plan）→ 执行（Do）→ 研究（Study）→ 行动（Act），通过循环试验改进流程。
P = PLAN / 计划

Plan / 计划

Define a problem, aim, proposed change, prediction and measures.
明确问题、目标、拟采取的改变、预期效果及衡量指标。
D = DO / 执行

Do / 执行

Test the change on a small scale and collect observations.
小范围测试改变并收集观察数据。
S = STUDY / 研究

Study / 研究

Analyze results and compare them with predictions.
分析结果，将实际结果与预期进行比较。
A = ACT / 行动

Act / 行动

Adopt, adapt or abandon the change and plan the next cycle.
决定采用、调整或放弃措施，并计划下一轮循环。

objective.en: Explore interactions and management challenges in complex care systems.
objective.zh: 理解医疗系统的相互依赖及管理挑战。

sections.title: PPT 24 · Defining Complex Systems and Healthcare as a Complex System
sections.html:
复杂系统及医疗复杂系统 · 2 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 24
Healthcare is a complex system: interconnected professions, processes and technologies interact dynamically and sometimes nonlinearly.
医疗是复杂系统：多种专业、流程和技术彼此关联，动态且可能非线性地相互影响。

Characteristics of Complex Systems / 复杂系统的特征

English · PPT content
Interconnected components interact dynamically and nonlinearly and evolve over time.
中文 · 课件对应解释
互相关联的部分以动态和非线性的方式相互作用，并随时间演变。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 24

Healthcare as a Complex System / 作为复杂系统的医疗机构

English · PPT content
Healthcare combines different professions, technologies and processes, producing dynamic and sometimes unpredictable interactions.
中文 · 课件对应解释
医疗系统整合不同专业、技术与流程，因此交互关系动态变化且有时难以预测。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 24

sections.title: PPT 25 · Interactions and Interdependencies in Healthcare Organizations
sections.html:
医疗机构的相互作用与相互依赖 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 25
Four interdependencies: provider coordination, patient involvement, administrative coordination and technology integration.
四种相互依赖：医护人员协作、患者参与、行政管理协调和技术整合。

Coordination Among Providers / 医疗人员协作

English · PPT content
Teamwork and communication support effective patient care.
中文 · 课件对应解释
依靠团队合作与沟通提供有效的患者照护。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 25

Patient Involvement / 患者参与

English · PPT content
Patients actively participate in their treatment plans and influence outcomes.
中文 · 课件对应解释
患者积极参与自身治疗计划，对治疗结果产生影响。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 25

Administrative Coordination / 行政管理协调

English · PPT content
Administrators manage resources and support clinical teams.
中文 · 课件对应解释
行政管理人员分配资源并支持临床团队。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 25

Technology Integration / 技术整合

English · PPT content
Medical technology supports clinical decisions and service efficiency.
中文 · 课件对应解释
医疗技术支持临床决策并提高服务效率。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 25

sections.title: PPT 26 · Challenges in Managing Complex Systems
sections.html:
管理复杂系统面临的四项挑战 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 26
Four management challenges: Unpredictability, Resistance to Change, Communication Barriers, and Measuring Performance.
四项管理挑战：不可预测性、变革阻力、沟通障碍与绩效衡量。

Unpredictability in Systems / 系统的不可预测性

English · PPT content
Unpredictable behaviour calls for flexible management strategies.
中文 · 课件对应解释
系统行为难以预测，需要灵活的管理策略。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 26

Resistance to Change / 变革阻力

English · PPT content
Stakeholders may resist change, complicating adaptation.
中文 · 课件对应解释
利益相关者可能抗拒变化，增加系统调整的难度。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 26

Communication Barriers / 沟通障碍

English · PPT content
Communication problems hinder coordination and management.
中文 · 课件对应解释
沟通问题妨碍协调与有效管理。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 26

Measuring Performance / 绩效衡量

English · PPT content
Performance is difficult to measure in complex systems and requires adaptive approaches.
中文 · 课件对应解释
复杂系统的表现难以衡量，需要采用灵活、适应性的管理方法。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 26

objective.en: Connect workflows, risk management and a culture of safety.
objective.zh: 理解系统行为、风险管理与安全文化。

sections.title: PPT 28 · System Behavior and Its Impact on Healthcare Outcomes
sections.html:
系统行为对医疗结果的影响 · 3 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 28
Efficient workflows, clear communication and early system-failure detection can protect care quality and patient safety.
高效工作流程、清晰沟通和及时识别系统故障，有助于保障医疗质量与患者安全。

Healthcare System Workflows / 医疗系统工作流程

English · PPT content
Efficient workflows improve quality and safety by streamlining processes.
中文 · 课件对应解释
通过精简流程提高效率、医疗质量及患者安全。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 28

Communication in Healthcare / 医疗沟通

English · PPT content
Clear communication among providers prevents errors and enhances outcomes.
中文 · 课件对应解释
医护人员之间清晰沟通，可预防错误并改善患者结果。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 28

System Failure Identification / 系统故障识别

English · PPT content
Detect failures early to prevent adverse events and improve safety.
中文 · 课件对应解释
尽早发现系统故障，预防不良事件，提高安全性。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 28
Classroom commentary / 老师课堂补充

Lecturer: system failures / 老师补充：系统故障

Unnecessary X-ray/CT examinations may increase radiation exposure and cost; staff should detect equipment problems early.
不必要的X光或CT可能增加辐射暴露和医疗开支；员工应及早发现设备故障。
Lesson 1-b

sections.title: PPT 29 · Patient Safety Concepts and Risk Management
sections.html:
患者安全概念与风险管理 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 29
Patient safety and risk management use four approaches: Error Prevention, Incident Reporting, Risk Assessment, and Mitigation Strategies.
患者安全与风险管理四项措施：错误预防、事故报告、风险评估和风险缓解策略。

Error Prevention / 错误预防

English · PPT content
Use strategies to avoid mistakes and improve care quality.
中文 · 课件对应解释
实施预防措施，减少差错，提高医疗质量。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 29

Incident Reporting / 事故报告

English · PPT content
Report incidents promptly to identify risks and improve safety.
中文 · 课件对应解释
及时报告事故以识别风险并改进安全措施。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 29

Risk Assessment / 风险评估

English · PPT content
Assess potential risks proactively to minimize harm.
中文 · 课件对应解释
主动评估潜在风险，尽量减少伤害。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 29

Mitigation Strategies / 风险缓解策略

English · PPT content
Use targeted measures to reduce hazards and improve care reliability.
中文 · 课件对应解释
使用有针对性的措施降低危险并提高医疗服务可靠性。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 29
Classroom commentary / 老师课堂补充

Lecturer: incident reporting / 老师补充：事故报告

Staff may hesitate to report incidents because of career concerns, but timely reporting supports investigation and prevention of recurrence.
员工可能因担心考核或晋升而不愿报告事故；老师强调及时报告有利于调查及防止再次发生。
Lesson 1-b

sections.title: PPT 30 · Cultivating a Culture of Safety in Healthcare
sections.html:
培养医疗安全文化 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 30
Four safety-culture components: Open Communication, Learning from Errors, Leadership Commitment, and Staff Engagement.
安全文化四个组成部分：开放沟通、从错误中学习、领导层承诺及员工参与。

Open Communication / 开放沟通

English · PPT content
Let staff share safety concerns and report errors safely.
中文 · 课件对应解释
鼓励员工提出安全隐患并安全地报告错误。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 30

Learning from Errors / 从错误中学习

English · PPT content
Learn from incidents, improve processes and prevent future harm.
中文 · 课件对应解释
从事故中吸取经验，改进流程并预防未来的患者伤害。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 30

Leadership Commitment / 领导层承诺

English · PPT content
Leaders uphold safety standards and support a culture of safety.
中文 · 课件对应解释
领导层维护安全标准并支持建立安全文化。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 30

Staff Engagement / 员工参与

English · PPT content
Staff actively join safety practices and continuous improvement.
中文 · 课件对应解释
员工积极参与安全实践及持续改善。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 30
Classroom commentary / 老师课堂补充

Lecturer: leadership and involvement / 老师补充：领导与参与

Leadership should support reporting and provide resources; staff participation in drills and training is essential.
领导层应支持事故报告并提供资源；员工应积极参加演练及培训。
Lesson 1-b

sections.title: PPT 31 · Conclusion
sections.html:
本讲总结 · 4 subtopics / 个子要点
BOLD KEY SUMMARY / 加粗核心总结 · PPT 31
Lecture synthesis: understand quality, manage costs without compromising outcomes, build QA systems, and account for safety culture and complexity.
本讲总括：理解医疗质量、在不牺牲患者结果的前提下管理成本、建设QA体系，并重视安全文化和复杂系统。

Understanding Quality in Healthcare / 理解医疗质量

English · PPT content
Clear quality definitions support healthcare management and patient care.
中文 · 课件对应解释
明确医疗质量的含义，有助于有效管理和改善患者照护。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 31

Cost Management / 成本管理

English · PPT content
Manage costs sustainably without compromising patient outcomes.
中文 · 课件对应解释
有效且可持续地管理成本，但不能牺牲患者结果。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 31

Quality Assurance Systems / 质量保证体系

English · PPT content
Strong QA systems support consistent safety and service standards.
中文 · 课件对应解释
完善的QA体系有助于持续保障患者安全及服务标准。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 31

Safety Culture and Complexity / 安全文化与复杂性

English · PPT content
Prioritize safety culture and account for healthcare system complexity.
中文 · 课件对应解释
重视安全文化，同时认识并应对医疗系统的复杂性。
Source: Lecture 1 PDF · Slide 31

question.en: List the four headings under “Understanding the Meaning of Healthcare Quality”.
question.zh: 列出“理解医疗质量的含义”下面的四个主点。

answer.en: Patient Outcomes Improvement; Safety and Effectiveness; Timely and Efficient Care; Equitable and Patient-Centered.
answer.zh: 改善患者结果；安全性与有效性；及时且高效的服务；公平且以患者为中心。

question.en: Which exact yellow-highlighted word belongs to Patient Outcomes Improvement?
question.zh: “改善患者结果”下方黄色高亮的英文词是什么？

question.en: Give the three highlighted expressions under Safety and Effectiveness.
question.zh: 列出“安全性与有效性”对应的三个黄色重点。

answer.zh: 安全且有效；减少（风险）；增加（获益）。

question.en: What highlighted phrase is under Timely and Efficient Care?
question.zh: “及时且高效的服务”下面的黄色重点是什么？

answer.zh: Better patient experience（更好的患者体验）。

question.en: Which highlighted word belongs to Equitable and Patient-Centered?
question.zh: “公平且以患者为中心”下面的黄色重点是什么？

question.en: What is highlighted under Effectiveness of Care?
question.zh: “医疗有效性”下面黄色高亮的内容是什么？

answer.zh: Desired health outcomes（预期健康结果）。

question.en: Name the five Key Dimensions of Quality in Healthcare Services.
question.zh: 医疗服务质量的五个关键维度是什么？

answer.en: Safety; Effectiveness; Patient-Centeredness; Timeliness and Efficiency; Equity.
answer.zh: 安全；有效性；以患者为中心；及时性与效率；公平性。

question.en: What are the three types of quality costs?

answer.zh: 预防成本、评估成本和失败成本。

question.en: Name the four Strategies for Reducing Quality Costs.
question.zh: 降低质量成本的四种策略是什么？

answer.en: Quality improvement programs; staff training; standardized protocols; technology for error prevention.
answer.zh: 质量改善计划；员工培训；标准化操作规程；错误预防技术。

question.en: Name the four Core Components of QA Systems.
question.zh: QA体系的四个核心组成部分是什么？

answer.en: Setting standards; monitoring performance; conducting audits; engaging staff in improvement.
answer.zh: 制定标准；监控绩效；开展审核；员工参与改善。

question.en: How do RCA and PDSA differ?

answer.en: RCA identifies underlying causes of problems; PDSA iteratively tests and improves processes.
answer.zh: RCA找出问题深层原因；PDSA循环测试与改进流程。

question.en: Expand PDSA and describe its four steps.
question.zh: 写出PDSA的全称并解释四步。

answer.en: Plan (design); Do (test); Study (analyze); Act (adopt, adapt or abandon). The detailed four-step explanation is a study expansion.
answer.zh: 计划（设计）；执行（测试）；研究（分析）；行动（采用、调整或放弃）。四步细节属于学习扩展。

question.zh: 医疗机构四种相互作用／依赖关系是什么？

answer.en: Coordination among providers; patient involvement; administrative coordination; technology integration.
answer.zh: 医护协作；患者参与；行政协调；技术整合。

question.en: What is the fourth challenge listed on slide 26?
question.zh: PPT第26页第四项复杂系统管理挑战是什么？

answer.zh: Measuring Performance（绩效衡量），不是资源限制。

question.en: Name the four patient-safety and risk-management concepts.
question.zh: 患者安全及风险管理的四个概念是什么？

answer.en: Error Prevention; Incident Reporting; Risk Assessment; Mitigation Strategies.
answer.zh: 错误预防；事故报告；风险评估；风险缓解策略。

question.en: Name the four components of a safety culture.
question.zh: 安全文化的四个组成部分是什么？

answer.en: Open Communication; Learning from Errors; Leadership Commitment; Staff Engagement.
answer.zh: 开放沟通；从错误中学习；领导层承诺；员工参与。

question.en: What does PDSA stand for? State its main use.
question.zh: PDSA的四个英文单词是什么？主要用途是什么？

answer.en: PDSA = Plan–Do–Study–Act. It iteratively tests and improves healthcare processes.
answer.zh: PDSA＝计划—执行—研究—行动。 它通过不断测试和总结来改进医疗流程。
